name: Las Burner — red charge sequence
notes:
Derived from the revised AI-generated sheet, matching the supplied reference with requested edits. Automatically reduced grid interpretation; small details differ from the reference. Grip/pivot/muzzle are initial estimates requiring rig checks. Preview slot W05 confirmed from repository pixelkit-v2 manifest at ae7247a9b94aeb834342cd40e8aea2eb82308bb8. This does not add firing behaviours.
Revision: weapons-v001. Status: draft. Pixel cleanup and anchor/scale review outstanding. Stored in isolated art/weapon-lab branch.

Laser-sequence-v001: four two-pixel red barrel lamps at x=26/29/32/35, y=9. Smooth overlapping rear-to-muzzle sequence; 32 frames at 20 fps (1.6 s). Eight body pixels form dark red unlit lamp seats; silhouette, alpha, anchors, trim, guts and scale unchanged. Existing cyan emissive remains a smooth pulse. Ambient loop only, no firing timing. Draft; gameplay-size recognition approval pending.
